items.body:
## Summary

The `pr-ready` gate now triggers like `UT`/`Code Check` (`pull_request_target`) and runs each suite on the runner it needs: Node tests + line coverage on the Linux `dm-nodeut` pool, Hypium and device ST on the macOS `harmonyos` runner, and a final job that merges the results into the same `gate-reports/pr-ready.json` the dashboard consumes.

## Changes

### Trigger

- `pull_request` → `pull_request_target` (opened/synchronize/reopened/ready_for_review), replaced rather than added so a PR does not run twice.
- Fork PRs no longer need "Approve and run workflows"; the workflow file always comes from the base branch, and only the tarball snapshot of the PR head is executed with `contents: read`.
- Concurrency is keyed by PR number (`pull_request_target` reports the base branch as `github.ref`), so different PRs do not cancel each other.

### Job split

| Job | Runner | Content |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pr-ready-node-ut` | Linux `dm-nodeut` (2 dedicated + flex) | `scripts/ci/node-ut.sh`: node suite + `NODE_V8_COVERAGE` + coverage threshold |
| `pr-ready-hypium-ut` | macOS `harmonyos` | `scripts/ci/hypium-ut.sh` |
| `pr-ready-st` | macOS `harmonyos` | `scripts/ci/st.sh` (credential-free attachment-policy ST) |
| `pr-ready-report` | Linux `dm-utility` | merges the three parts into `gate-reports/pr-ready.json` |

The jobs stay ordered (`node-ut` → `hypium-ut` → `st` → `report`); a failed prerequisite skips the rest and still produces a failing report. Job names carry a `pr-ready-` prefix so their checks do not collide with `ut.yml`'s `node-ut`/`hypium-ut`. The report job loads `scripts/gate/merge-pr-ready.mjs` and `.github/ci-gates.json` from the **base** snapshot, so PR code cannot rewrite its own verdict. Artifact uploads remain best-effort; the merged status comes from job outcomes with durations from `ci-gate-part-*`.

### Coverage

- `scripts/ci/node-tests.sh` picks up `profiling-report.test.mjs` and `performance.test.mjs`; UT's node-ut already ran them and the lists had drifted.
- `coverage-gate.mjs` now prints the real scope. On this branch: **575 production `.ets` files under the roots, 51 loaded by tests (8.9%), 524 never loaded and excluded from the denominator**; the reported **77.0–77.3% line coverage is over the 51 loaded files only**, not the module. Threshold stays on loaded files so the gate does not collapse before the loaders are fixed; the scope line makes the gap explicit.
- Why files are missing: many tests load `.ets` snippets through `vm.runInThisContext/runInNewContext` without a real `filename` (4 support loaders plus 83 test files use inline vm). Fixing those and including unloaded files requires recalibrating `COVERAGE_MIN_LINES` — proposed as a follow-up.

## Validation

- Local `node scripts/gate/gate.mjs run --lane pr-ready`: **pass**, 335s (node-ut 142.6s, hypium 161.2s, st 31.3s).
- Unit tests: `merge-pr-ready` 4/4, gate/coverage suite 16/16; actionlint clean apart from the existing custom-label and SC2115 notes.
- Dispatched workflow run [41185423737](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/41185423737): **all four jobs success** — node-ut 80s, hypium 336s, st 27s; `ci-gates-reports` contains `pr-ready` verdict `pass` with the three commands and durations.

## Caveats

- Edits to `ci.yml`/`scripts/ci/*` take effect in the PR gate after they land on main; validate inside a PR with `workflow_dispatch --ref <branch>` or locally.
- PR code still executes on self-hosted runners without approval (same class of risk as `UT/node-ut` and `Code Check`); the ST suite stays credential-free.

## Retire UT

`ut.yml` is deleted too. `pr-ready-node-ut` (#214) and `pr-ready-hypium-ut` already run the same suites, on the same runner split, with the same `pull_request_target` trigger and tarball fetch — keeping UT meant the Node suite ran twice per pull request and the two file lists kept drifting.

- `ci-gate.test.mjs` now asserts the CI jobs, the per-runner layout, the tarball fetch, and that `ut.yml` does not come back; the `ENABLE_HYPIUM_UT` assertions are gone.
- Node discovery has one source of truth: `scripts/ci/node-tests.sh`.
- Full node suite after the change: 2450 pass, 2 skipped.

After merge, delete the leftover **UT** workflow registration in Actions (sidebar → UT → ⋯ → Delete workflow), the same cleanup as `diag-st` / `E2E nightly`. The `ENABLE_HYPIUM_UT` repository variable is now unused and can be removed.

## Retire Claude PR Review

`claude-review.yml` is removed as well. It was gated by `vars.ENABLE_AI_REVIEW == 'true'`, which is not set — the last 100 runs were all `skipped`, so it only added a skipped check to every pull request. The publisher-script tests in `issue-workflows.test.mjs` were removed with it (the issue-template tests stay, 30/30).

`ANTHROPIC_*` secrets stay: the Nightly E2E job uses them for AI scoring. After merge, delete the **Claude PR Review** registration in the Actions sidebar (same cleanup as UT). `ENABLE_AI_REVIEW` was never set, nothing to remove there.

items.body:
## 问题

`chat.final` 的落地路径先解析「这条 final 覆盖哪个分段」，`parseChatFinalSegmentId()` 把四个候选字段塞进 `string[]` 后逐个 `.trim()`。帧是服务端下发的 JSON，`Payload.segment_id?: string` 只是编译期声明；消息 id 在服务端常是整数，`||` 只吞掉 `0`/`''`，非零数字会原样进入数组并让 `.trim()` 抛 `TypeError`。

在 `0fb0456` 上实测：

```
parseChatFinalSegmentId({ segment_id: 42 })        → TypeError: value.trim is not a function
session.apply({event:'chat.final',
  payload:{request_id:'turn', content:'最终回答', stream_message_id: 98765}})
                                                   → TypeError: value.trim is not a function
```

异常发生在帧分发里，被 `CloudConnection` 的 `try/catch` 转成 `onProtocolError('消息处理失败，详见通信日志')`：这条 final 的正文整条丢失，同一轮的 `finishTurn()` 也没执行，用户看到的是通用错误提示而不是回复。

Fixes #410

## 改动

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudFinal.ets`（+11/−6）：

- 候选值按 `string | undefined` 收集，逐个 `typeof value !== 'string'` 跳过，字符串路径仍 `trim()` 后返回；
- 四个字段都不可用时返回 `''`（表示写到客户端当前分段），不再抛异常；
- 与同文件 `parseChatFinalMode()` 已有的 `typeof raw !== 'string'` 校验保持一致。

不改协议、不改分段选择策略、不改任何网络行为；只是不再让一个可选字段的类型把整条 final 打掉。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/cloud-final-segment-id.test.mjs`，**先失败后通过**（`0fb0456` 上 4 条中 3 条失败）：

| 用例 | 断言 |
| --- | --- |
| 数字型 `segment_id` / `stream_message_id` | 返回 `''`，不抛异常 |
| 前一个候选不可用、后一个可用 | 取到 `'m-9'`；`'seg-1'` 原样返回；`'  seg-2  '` 被 trim |
| `parseChatFinalMode` 非字符串 | 仍返回 `''`（回归保护） |
| 带数字 `stream_message_id` 的 `chat.final` | 回复落进气泡、`completed === true`、会话回到 `idle` |

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-final-segment-id.test.mjs   # 4/4
node --test tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs                  # 517 tests · 514 pass · 3 fail
```

3 条失败是本地缺依赖的既有基线（`Cannot find module 'typescript'` ×2、`'playwright'` ×1，CI 的 `ut.yml` 会安装），与本次改动无关。`CloudFinal.ets` 此前在 `tests/unit` 里没有任何覆盖，这个文件顺带补上。

## 未验证

- 服务端线上是否真的会下发数字型分段 id：仓库内没有服务端代码，无法证实。本 PR 修的是「客户端把可选字段做成硬失败点」这一可复现事实，而不是声称线上已发生。
- 真机渲染与 ArkTS 编译：沙箱无真机与 ArkTS 工具链，由 CI 的 ArkTS Code Check 覆盖。

## 风险与回滚

行为面很小：只有非字符串候选值从「抛异常」变成「跳过」。若服务端确实永远只发字符串，这个改动等价于空操作。回滚只需 revert 这一个 commit。

## 问题

引用条（回复气泡上方的 `Beebou：…`）和输入框里的「引用回答」卡片显示的是 `markdownPreviewText()` 的输出。它在 `main` `0fb0456` 上有三个可见缺陷：

1. **截断没有省略号**：预览在 140 个 UTF-16 码元处硬切，被切断的半句话看起来像完整回答。
2. **emoji 处出现方块**：切口落在代理对中间时留下半个字符（`'答'×139 + '😀…'` → 尾部 `\ud83d`），渲染为 �。
3. **表格泄漏源码**：表格回答的预览是 `| 城市 | 温度 | | 北京 | 12 |`，用户看到 `|` 与 `---` 分隔行。

Fixes #404

## 改动

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudReplyPreview.ets`（+34/−6）：

- `clipCharacters()`：按 UTF-16 码点边界截断，绝不切开代理对（截断点落在高位代理上时回退一个码元）。
- `clipPreview()`：只有真的超长才补 `…`，未超长的预览保持原样（与 `permissionDetail` 等处的 `…` 约定一致）。
- 表格块（`kind === 'code' && table`）走既有的 `parseMarkdownTable()`，按单元格扁平化为 `城市 温度 北京 12`，不再输出 `|`。
- 解析上限 4096 也用同一套安全截断，避免解析入口产生孤立代理。

不动气泡正文渲染、不动流式管线、不改 Markdown 解析器（#402 处理正文强调，二者不重叠）。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/cloud-reply-preview.test.mjs`，**先失败后通过**（在 `0fb0456` 上 4 条中 3 条失败：缺省略号、`\ud83d` 孤立代理、`|` 泄漏；修复后 4/4 通过）：

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-reply-preview.test.mjs
```

回归范围：

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-message-actions.test.mjs
ℹ tests 532 · pass 529 · fail 3
```

3 条失败全部是本地缺依赖导致的既有基线，与本次改动无关：`Cannot find module 'typescript'`（`cloud-account-service`、`cloud-embedding`）、`Cannot find module 'playwright'`（`cloud-math-renderer`）；CI 的 `ut.yml` 会安装这些依赖。既有的「公式在预览里必须可读」契约测试（`digitalmate-message-actions.test.mjs`）保持通过。

## 未验证

- 真机字体/换行下的实际显示：仓库无 ArkTS 工具链与真机，只能靠 CI 的 ArkTS Code Check 与纯函数测试。
- 未改动任何服务端或协议行为。

## 风险与回滚

预览文本形状变化（长文多一个 `…`、表格由 `|` 变空格），UI 侧本就用 `maxLines` + `TextOverflow.Ellipsis`，不冲突。改动是单文件纯函数，回滚只需 revert 这一个 commit。

items.body:
## What this fixes

Markdown emphasis in a Chinese reply leaked its markers into the bubble and broke the sentence style:

- `***两者***` rendered as `*` + bold `两者` + `*`
- `**粗体 *内斜* 混排**` rendered as five spans (`*`, italic `粗体 `, plain `内斜`, italic ` 混排`, `*`) — the outer bold was lost entirely

Cause: the bold branch of `parsePlainInline()` only accepted content without an asterisk (`\*\*([^*]+)\*\*`), so any nested emphasis made the whole span fail and the leftover markers fell through as plain text.

Fixes #402. Same rendering pipeline as #357 (multi-line content shown unrendered) and independent of #360 (table separator rows).

## How it works

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudMarkdown.ets`:

- The bold branch now accepts inner emphasis: `\*\*((?:[^*]|\*[^*]+\*)+)\*\*`, which covers `**粗体 *内斜* 混排**`, and `***x***` (the inner `*x*` matches, so the whole triple form lands on the bold branch).
- The captured text has its inner `*` markers removed before the span is created: `Inline` carries a single style, so the outer bold wins and no marker reaches the bubble. A numeric inner pair is the exception: `**5*3*2 = 30**` is arithmetic, so its asterisks stay literal (`boldPlainText()`), while `***x***` keeps rendering as bold `x`.
- Ordered before the backtick branch as before, so inline code and fenced code keep their asterisks literal.

No new dependency, no protocol change, no content dropped — only the markers.

## Tests (failing first)

New `tests/unit/cloud-markdown-emphasis.test.mjs`, 4 cases; red on `0fb0456` (each assertion showed the stray `*` spans above), green after the fix.

| Case | Expectation |
| --- | --- |
| `***两者***` | one bold span, text `两者` |
| `价格 ***99*** 元` | `价格 ` + bold `99` + ` 元` |
| `**粗体 *内斜* 混排**` | one bold span, text `粗体 内斜 混排` |
| `结论：**关键 *点* 已确认**。` | prefix + one bold span + `。` |
| `**粗体**`, `*斜体*`, `==高亮==`, `**粗体** 与 *斜体*` | unchanged |
| `` `a *** b` `` | literal `a *** b` inside a code span |

Whole markdown set on this branch (`cloud-markdown`, `cloud-markdown-links`, `cloud-markdown-layout`, `markdown-render-st`, plus the new suite): **65 pass / 0 fail**.

## Non-goals

- No nested rich text: `Inline` keeps its single-style contract, the outer span wins.
- No change to table recognition (#360's area) or to linkification.
- No new dependency, no logging, no permission change.

## Risk

The only new behaviour is that literal asterisks nested inside a bold span are dropped, except for a numeric inner pair, which stays literal because dropping it would change the value the user reads (`**5*3*2 = 30**` used to become `532 = 30`). A product written with one star and no closing partner (`**2*3**`) is not matched by the bold branch at all and behaves as before (verified: `*` + italic `2` + `3**` on both `0fb0456` and this branch) — the earlier example in this description was wrong. Code spans are matched first and keep their asterisks, and the existing behaviours (`**bold**`, `*italic*`, ``code``) are pinned by the tests. Rollback is a one-line regex revert plus the handler line.

items.body:
## 问题

「执行步骤」卡片、子代理活动行和步骤摘要都经过 `brief()`（`CloudMessage.ets`）。它只认 `data:` URL 一种二进制形态，而且 scheme 匹配会跨过 JSON 引号：

1. **裸露 base64 不被遮蔽**：`{"image_base64":"iVBORw0KGgo" + "A"×600}` 原样输出 612 个字符（最长到 12000 字符上限），图片生成工具的字节铺满步骤卡片。
2. **多个内联 data URL 被合并**：`{"images":["data:...","data:..."]}` → `{"images":["[二进制内容]"]}`，第二张图消失——`data:[^\s]+;base64,` 会吃到最后一个 `;base64,`，把中间字段吞掉。

Fixes #407

## 改动

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudMessage.ets`（+6/−1）：

- `data:[^"\s]+;base64,` —— 遇到引号即止，两个二进制条目各自遮蔽，JSON 结构与同级字段保持完整。
- 新增 `[A-Za-z0-9+/]{200,}={0,2}` —— 不带 scheme 的裸 base64（≥200 连续字符）同样折叠为 `[二进制内容]`；阈值远大于任何正常标识符，普通文本、短数字、URL 主机名与 `?download_token=` 既有遮蔽行为不变。
- 不改气泡正文、不改协议、不改任何网络行为。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/cloud-binary-mask.test.mjs`，**先失败后通过**（`0fb0456` 上 5 条中 2 条失败：裸 base64 未遮蔽、两个 data URL 合并；修复后 5/5）：

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-binary-mask.test.mjs
```

回归范围（cloud-* 与 digitalmate-*）：

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-*.test.mjs
ℹ tests 1015 · pass 1012 · fail 3
```

3 条失败全部是本地缺依赖导致的既有基线，与本次改动无关：`Cannot find module 'typescript'`（`cloud-account-service`、`cloud-embedding`）、`Cannot find module 'playwright'`；CI 的 `ut.yml` 会安装这些依赖。

## 未验证

- 真机上步骤卡片的排版：仓库无 ArkTS 工具链与真机，只能靠 CI 的 ArkTS Code Check 与纯函数测试。
- 遮蔽阈值 200 是启发式：≥200 连续 `[A-Za-z0-9+/]` 视为编码数据。签名 URL 的超长路径段也会被折叠（主机名仍可见），这是有意的取舍。

## 风险与回滚

只影响步骤/活动文本的显示内容，不改变消息正文与协议。单文件纯函数，回滚只需 revert 这一个 commit。

items.body:
Fixed-step tests could finish despite missed actions or incomplete evidence. This change freezes reviewed DAG contracts for 14 E2E workflows and 7 ST cases, records their actual execution paths, and makes contract differences fail CI.

## Changes

- Store versioned JSON baselines under `tests/dag/standards/{e2e,st}` and generate actual DAGs, machine-readable differences, and an offline HTML view for each run.
- Reject missing/reordered steps, changed actions or targets, invalid optional skips, unverified effects, stale run/definition identities, and missing or inconsistent evidence. Re-read execution logs and confined screenshot/UI files instead of trusting a previous PASS result.
- Run baseline and fault-injection checks in UT and the shared `scripts/ci/node-tests.sh` ci-gates lane. Gate all 14 E2E DAGs in nightly, and propagate ST DAG failures through the report command, JUnit, and exit code. AI content/visual scoring remains separate.
- Enforce ST DAG contracts only in business/connection modes. Preserve attachment-policy test outcomes with explicit `dagCoverage: not-covered`; missing standards in covered modes still fail.
- Align CHAT-01/CHAT-02/FILE-02 UI scoring with observable cards, time replies, activity completion, final file content and retention. Their titles/goals explicitly exclude proving unavailable tool traces or two underlying writes. Honour `tap.button` exact/substring matching through the runner and driver.
- Pin ST contracts in the generated test package, align E2E score evidence with snapshots, and remove the CLI's implicit pre-case state reset.
- Verify option selection through the answer value or selected marker, including when page text is unchanged. Continue to require a verified submission effect; a no-op selection fails.
- Open the native live activity panel for status/progress checkpoints and use its artifact tab instead of Settings. Return to the conversation before continuing FILE-02 and TRAVEL-01. Require the observed details surface in DAG evidence.
- Retain node-scoped before/after images, checkpoint copies, failure frames, complete UI trees, capture timestamps, device/App/source metadata, and SHA-256 manifests. Preserve action failures when capture fails; independently verify auxiliary evidence and reject missing, edited, or misattributed files.
- Link DAG differences to highlighted nodes with offline image/UI/manifest review. Annotate measured first-tap targets only when matched in the before UI tree; later taps retain event records without inventing intermediate screenshots. Unexecuted nodes have no fabricated images and link to interruption context.
- Fix emulator issues: detect the notification-settings overlay, receive screenshots through unique paths to prevent stale PNG suffixes, and use verified Back key events on known emulators.

Generated contracts are a review tripwire derived from test definitions, not an independent behavioral oracle. The README documents how to review their source/JSON differences, why any edit to the entire `LiveBusiness.test.ets` source requires regenerating ST hashes, and why the always-running nightly gate intentionally fails on incomplete product, infrastructure, or evidence outcomes.

The native activity page exposes status/progress summaries, not per-tool traces. Navigation success does not prove a `date` call, two file writes, or the absence of tools. CHAT-01 now scores greeting/card behavior, CHAT-02 time replies and corresponding activity completion, and FILE-02 final-card/content/retention behavior. Actual tool execution, absence of tools, and two underlying writes remain outside these UI assertions and require attributable server-side evidence.

## Validation

- 113 focused Node tests passed: `tests/dag/dag.test.mjs`, `tests/e2e/workflow/workflow.test.mjs`, `tests/unit/digitalmate-device-st.test.mjs`, and `tests/e2e/workflow/profiling-report.test.mjs`. Added coverage for image/overlay tampering, missing manifests, run identity, path escapes, later-tap attribution, partial captures, and preserving primary failures.
- Review regressions reproduce five passing attachment-policy cases through the shared report and CLI (exit 0), retain real policy failures, reject unknown business cases without standards, and verify `tap.button` matching and runner parameter forwarding. The latest review changes were validated offline; device/AI scoring was not rerun against the revised contracts.
- All 21 frozen DAG contracts passed `node tests/dag/cli.mjs --check`; workflow schemas are covered by the focused tests. Driver/shared CI shell syntax and whitespace checks passed.
- After the visual-evidence changes and before the latest scoring-contract update, emulator `127.0.0.1:5555` completed CHAT-01 (`dag-visual-evidence-20261031-r1`). Independent checking verified all 10 nodes with zero differences, including 10 manifests, 9 image/UI capture pairs, and 2 measured target overlays. Source metadata honestly records the modified working tree used for capture.
- A controlled failure before sending a new message retained the original exception and failure image, marked later steps unexecuted, and failed the independent gate as expected. Edge headless rendered the offline report and its evidence images successfully.
- Earlier emulator checks verified native activity/artifact navigation and both Back effects. Before the latest Node-only changes, the debug app and independent ST HAP compiled locally; ST used the cached published Hypium 1.0.25 HAR after a registry TLS failure, without changing repository dependencies.

The full BACK-01 journey previously stopped at an app `回复失败` response. All 14 E2E journeys and AI visual/content scoring have not been validated together. Existing chat history was preserved, so CHAT-01's empty-conversation precondition is not claimed as passing. Live business ST is not claimed as passing; separate remote validation is tracked at https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/41179317276. Six collector tests in a broader Windows run also failed on the unchanged `db299fa` baseline. Review images are execution evidence, not approved visual baselines or pixel-scoring assertions.

Scope is limited to ST/E2E test tooling and CI. See `tests/dag/README.md` for the contract format, baseline review/update workflow, output paths, and gate commands.

items.body: ## What this fixes Reply bubbles could print unresolved tool-protocol payloads verbatim, e.g. ``` 好的，<|DSML|native_read_source {"path":"attachment-1"}|> ``` Three client-side text paths had no filter at all: `CloudSession.flush()` (`+=` on every stream delta), `applyFinalAnswer()` (`target.text = content`), and `applyHistory()` (rebuilds bubbles from stored raw text, so leaked history showed up again after a cold start). This PR adds the last line of defence: whatever the server does, the user only sees natural language. Fixes #395. Root cause of the original report (unregistered/unexecuted tool, DSML emitted by the model) stays in #330 — this PR does not touch the server, it only guarantees the bubble never renders protocol text. ## How it works New pure module `digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudProtocolText.ets`: - `splitToolProtocol(text)` → `{ visible, hold }`: complete `<|...|>` spans are removed; a trailing incomplete span whose marker name matches a known protocol prefix (`dsml`, `tool_call`, `tool_result`, `endoftext`, `eot_id`, `im_start`, `im_end`) is held back until it closes (or is dropped at end of turn); anything else — a plain `<`, a `` tag, an over-long `<|` that does not look like a protocol marker — is left untouched. - `stripToolProtocol(text)` → `visible` only. `CloudSession` now keeps the unfiltered stream per message in `rawText` and recomputes `row.text` through `stripToolProtocol(raw)` on every delta, so a marker split across deltas never leaks a partial fragment. The same filter is applied to non-streaming `chat.final` (append / replace_turn / patch paths, with `rawText` kept in sync) and to history reconstruction. Nothing else in the session lifecycle changes; no new dependency, no protocol change, no permission change, no prompt/response logging. ## Tests (failing first) `tests/unit/cloud-reply-protocol-text.test.mjs` — 6 cases, loads the real classes through the existing `tests/support/cloud-test-loader.mjs`, no device or backend needed. Red first: before the module existed the suite failed with `ENOENT ... CloudProtocolText.ets`. | Case | Expectation | | --- | --- | | plain text | `你好，我在。` unchanged | | complete DSML block | dropped | | `<|endoftext|>` | dropped | | `a < b` | preserved | | `` form | dropped | | empty input | empty | Session-level: | Case | Expectation | | --- | --- | | marker split across three deltas | bubble is `好的，我看看文件。` | | trailing unclosed fragment | dropped, bubble is `查完了。` | | non-streaming `chat.final` | bubble is `查一下好的` | | history rebuild after resume | bubble is `这是历史回复` | | ordinary `` tags in text | preserved: `第一段，和 粗体 标签。` | Green after the fix: **193 pass / 0 fail** across `cloud-reply-protocol-text`, `cloud-chat`, `cloud-reply-content`, `cloud-reply-images`, `cloud-page-state`, `cloud-task-recovery`. Full `tests/unit` sweep on this base: 999 pass / 6 fail; all 6 failures are missing local devDependencies (`typescript`, `playwright`) that the `ut.yml` workflow installs, and none of them is touched by this PR. ## Non-goals - No server-side tool parsing/registration work; #330 keeps the root cause. - No new dependencies, no protocol change, no permission widening, no prompt/response content logged. - Tool failures are still reported to the user through the existing error surface — this only stops the raw protocol text from being rendered as body copy. - Pre-existing history rows already stored upstream are not rewritten; they are simply no longer displayed. ## Risk The only failure mode is over-filtering legitimate text. It is bounded to closed `<|...|>` spans and to unclosed tails whose marker name matches a known protocol prefix; every other `<` keeps its behaviour, and two of the six tests pin that down. Rollback is a single revert of three files.

items.body:
## What this fixes

A turn that stops receiving events while the websocket stays healthy leaves the UI in "running" indefinitely. Reconnect reconciliation only runs when the connection drops (`CloudChatManager.reconcileAfterReconnect`), so a silent turn is never checked and the user is left with a half sentence and no way to tell whether the answer is still coming — the exact现场 in #379 (回复只有「我核对一下具体是谁说的。」，之后无任何输出，也没有失败提示或重试入口).

The session now watches that silence itself: after one minute without any event on a turn that still owes output, the conversation raises a single `warn` notice ("云端仍在处理，近一分钟没有新的输出。可以继续等待，或停止任务后重试。"). It never changes the run state, never fabricates a failure, and disappears the moment the cloud says anything again.

Fixes #398. See also #379 (user-visible report) and #373 (execution-time opacity).

## How it works

`CloudSession`:

- `watchQuiet()` restarts the silence clock and drops a shown hint. It is called from `beginTurn()` and on every frame the session accepts in `apply()`, so only a genuine gap counts.
- The timer fires at most once per quiet stretch (`quietHint` latches until the next event), only while `state` is `running` or `sending` — a paused turn, a turn waiting on an unanswered question, a stopped turn and a finished turn all have their own state and never see the hint.
- `settleQuiet()` stops the clock and removes the hint on `finishTurn()` and on `beginTurn()` of the next turn, so nothing leaks across turns.
- The hint is only placed when `notice` is empty: a real error/notice is never overwritten.
- The threshold is a constructor parameter (`new CloudSession(id, quietHintMs)`), defaulting to the exported `QUIET_HINT_MS = 60000`; tests pass a short value instead of sleeping a minute.

No new protocol, no server change, no new dependency, no logging of prompt/response content, no permission change. Rollback is a revert of two files.

## Tests (failing first)

`tests/unit/cloud-session-quiet-watch.test.mjs` — 7 cases, real `CloudSession` through the existing `tests/support/cloud-test-loader.mjs`, no device or backend.

Red first: before the change the suite failed with `assert.ok(session.notice)` — a silent running turn produced no notice at all.

| Case | Expectation |
| --- | --- |
| running turn, no events | `warn` notice containing「仍在处理」, `state` stays `running` |
| output resumes | notice cleared at once, bubble text continues normally |
| turn finished before the threshold | no notice, `state` is `idle` |
| turn waiting on the user (`chat.ask_user_question`) | no notice (`state` is `waiting`) |
| a real notice already shown | untouched (`连接已中断` stays) |
| silence continues | notice does not repeat |
| next turn starts | no leftover notice from the previous turn |

Green after the change: 7/7. Whole `cloud-*` unit set on this branch: 517 pass / 3 fail, and the 3 failures are the missing local devDependencies (`typescript` ×2, `playwright` ×1) that `ut.yml` installs — none of them touches `CloudSession`.

## Non-goals

- No automatic failure state, no new terminal state, no retry RPC: the client cannot verify the turn is dead, and inventing a failure would be worse than the silence.
- No server-side change; if the cloud really stops answering, a proper terminal event still has to come from the backend (#367/#379).
- No change to execution/step presentation (that is #373/#375).

## Risk

The only risk is a false alarm during a legitimately long non-streaming tool phase (#322): the notice is worded as "still working", changes no state, blocks no input, is cleared by the next event and appears once per quiet stretch, with a one-minute threshold. Worst case the user sees one informational line on a long turn.

items.body:
Closes #242。与 #235 的状态栏内容重叠是另一类问题，本 PR 只处理 Beebou 形象浮层。

## 问题

收起态的 Beebou 是页面 `Stack` 上的绝对定位浮层：头像 `x: '50%'`、名字胶囊 `width('100%')` 居中、提醒气泡居中，三层都在 `topInset` 附近的阅读区上方。列表顶部的占位只在滚到顶部时生效，一旦上滑（#242 截图就是把用户提问滚到最上层再看），消息就从这三层底下穿过，用户无法核对自己刚发的内容。名字胶囊还是整条横幅的点击区，顶部这条横带被它拦截。

## 改动

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/OrbitHome/Index.ets`
- 收起态头像**贴右边缘停靠**：`x: '100%'` + `translate(-52)`，82vp 的盒子里 52vp 可见，其余出屏；可见条同时是点击区（≥44vp 触控标准）。徽标改到可见侧，避免跑到屏外。打开实时活动面板时仍回到面板原来居中的位置（面板里 `Blank().height(72)` 早已为它留位）。
- 删除常驻居中的「Beebou」胶囊。名字 + 进度文案改为**只在 `petCaption()` 非空时**出现的小胶囊，停在头像左侧，外层 Row 用 `HitTestMode.Transparent`，不再拦截顶部按钮；点按进实时活动、长按看进展的行为保留。
- 提醒气泡从屏幕中间移到头像下方右侧边缘，仍可 × 关闭（临时提示）。
- `digitalmate-live-activity` 这个 id 移到头像容器上，`DM-WF-BACK-01` 的选择器不变。

`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/OrbitHome/OrbitPetAvatar.ets`
- 空闲时**隔一会动一会**：以静帧为主，每 4–9s 抖动 1.4s（200ms 交叉淡化），三张图常驻挂载避免换源闪动；`aboutToDisappear` 清定时器；`reduceMotion` 仍只用静帧；任务执行中保持连续播放（进度信号）。

## 验证

- 新增 `tests/unit/orbit-pet-dock.test.mjs`：停靠位置、身份胶囊不再横跨顶部且点击不被拦截、空闲抖动节律（用假定时器跑组件真实分支）。三个用例在 main 源码上全部失败，本分支全部通过。
- `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs`：2144 个用例，2130 通过；7 个失败均为本机环境原因（缺 `playwright`、`EPERM: fsync`），与改动无关。
- **未验证**：本机没有 HarmonyOS SDK/hvigor，未做 ArkTS 编译，也没有真机/模拟器截图，视觉与手感需要在设备上确认。

## 已知取舍

顶部横带（抽屉按钮、标题所在）本来就是内容从底下滚过的沉浸式设计，头像停靠在这条横带的右端：气泡正文中间完全让开了，但消息滚到最顶端时仍会从头像下方经过，与抽屉按钮一致。若 UCD 方案要求任何滚动位置都零遮挡，需要把顶部改成真正的布局区（列表不再滚到顶栏之下），属于更大的结构改动，可在此基础继续。#242 的评论提到 UCD 方案还在跟进，允许的话请一并确认方向。

items.body:
## 问题

最新 main 上，Orbit 设备 ST 的测试 HAP **编译不出来**。

```
.\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
→ COMPILE RESULT:FAIL {ERROR:22 WARN:100}
  Error: Property 'trajectory' does not exist on type 'ProductionComposer'
  Error: Property 'profilingEnabled' does not exist on type 'ProductionComposer'
  Error: Cannot find name 'OrbitResponse' / 'OrbitRequest'
  Error: Cannot find module '@loop/cloud-adapter'
```

## 根因

`tests/dfx/stability/orbit-device/ComposerHost.ets` 是一个**手写**的 host 类，承载 `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs` 从生产 `OrbitHome/Index.ets` **逐字提取**的 `send` / `drainSend` 方法体。

生产代码这阵子给这两个方法加了 trajectory 打点、profiling 开关和 draft 行状态，但 host 没跟着声明。提取是逐字的，所以方法体里引用了 host 上不存在的成员——编译必失败。

这是 main 上的既有缺陷，**与任何新用例无关**。已用未修改的 main（`5d574e36`）直接复现。

## 改动

| 文件 | 改动 |
|---|---|
| `ComposerHost.ets` | 引入并实例化生产 `OrbitTrajectory` 作为 `trajectory`；补 `profilingEnabled`（关闭）、`traceSubmissionId`、`draftNeedsOwnRow`；补 `OrbitRequest`/`OrbitResponse` 导入 |
| `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs` | 拷贝 `OrbitTrajectory.ets` 并在 `orbit/index.ets` 导出；改写 `OrbitDeviceContext.ets` 的 `'@loop/cloud-adapter'` 别名 |
| `tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` | 两个新守卫 |

### 为什么用真实 `OrbitTrajectory` 而不是空实现

它是纯逻辑类，只依赖 `hilog` 和 `OrbitProtocol` 的计时类型，没有 UI 依赖。用真实实现意味着提取出来的 `send`/`drainSend` 仍然调用**产品本来的**记录器，而不是我在测试里伪造一个。这符合这套 ST 的原则：产品方法逐字执行，测试只补 UI 生命周期。

`profilingEnabled` 设为 `false`，与页面默认值一致，让产品 `send` 走非诊断分支。`traceSubmissionId` / `draftNeedsOwnRow` 也取页面初始值。

### 两个守卫

这次问题的本质是「手写 host 与逐字提取的方法体失配」，而且**只有到真机跑才会发现**。所以补了两个单元守卫：

1. **成员完备性**：提取出的方法体里每个 `this.<member>`，必须能在 host 上解析（`extractSupport` 注入的方法算数）。缺失即报 `ProductionComposer is missing: x, y`。
2. **别名改写**：直接对生成产物断言，任何生成的 `.ets` 都不得残留 `'@loop/'`。这比匹配 prepare 的源码写法可靠。

守卫已验证有效：删掉 `trajectory` 那一行，立刻报
```
AssertionError: ProductionComposer is missing: trajectory
```

## 验证

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs`（干净 main + 本 commit） | **25/25 通过** |
| 守卫有效性 | 移除 `trajectory` → 报 `missing: trajectory`；恢复 → 全绿 |
| `-CompileOnly -Cases core`（本分支） | **`CompileOnly succeeded`**，`Verified test HAP: SDK runner and all six business case implementations are present.` |
| 生成物别名 | 生成后 `OrbitDeviceContext.ets` 内已无 `@loop` |
| `git diff --check` | 通过 |

编译是**实际执行**的，不是推断：本机 hvigor 已跑通，输出见上。

**未做：** 没有在真机跑业务用例（需要 Gateway Bearer，当前环境没有）。本 PR 只修编译，不改任何用例语义。

## 复现

```powershell
# 修复前
git checkout 5d574e36
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
# → COMPILE RESULT:FAIL {ERROR:22}

# 修复后
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
# → CompileOnly succeeded
```

## 与其他 PR 的关系

与 #296（新增 #233/#278、#241 的 ST 回归用例）**相互独立**，可分别合并。#296 也包含同样的编译修复（否则它自己的新用例也编不过）；本 PR 先合入后，#296 可以 rebase 掉这部分。

## 关联 Issue

- #233（`==` 标记泄漏，已由 #257 修）与 #278（等号比较被吞，已由 #269 修）
- #241（停止按钮无响应，已由 #268 修）

三个 issue 的修复都已在 main 上。本 PR **不改产品代码**，只把这三处行为补成设备级 ST 回归，避免以后同一个正则或同一处任务定位再退化。

## 做了什么

新增两条 Orbit 真实业务 ST 用例，并保持既有用例行为不变。

### `markup` — 等号比较与高亮标记解析（#233 / #278）

- 把**生产**的 `CloudMarkdown.ets` / `CloudMath.ets` 一起编译进独立 ST HAP，断言直接调用 `parseInline` / `parseMarkdownTable`，而不是复制一份正则到测试里（复制出来的正则会和生产实现漂移，正是这两个 issue 的成因）。
- 先要求模型原样回显一行混合文本，再对**该任务实际返回的回复**做断言：
  1. 每个带空格的比较片段（`a == b`、`if x == 0`）必须原样保留在可见文本里；
  2. 比较不得被渲染成 highlight（这正是 #278 里操作数被删掉的原因）；
  3. 紧贴文字的 `==标记==` 仍然高亮，且原始 `==标记==` 不残留在气泡文本里（#233 的症状）；
  4. 表格单元格路径同样成立：`` `a == b == c` `` 保持字面量，裸 `==25%==` 仍高亮。
- 不写死期望字符串：断言遍历回复中**实际出现**的比较片段，模型多说或少说不会被误判成通过。

### `stop` — 停止正在运行的任务（#241）

- 用 `extractRuntimeMethods` 从 `OrbitTaskRuntime.ets` **逐字提取** `topLevelTaskId` / `stopTarget` / `stopTask`，包进 `OrbitStopTarget`，仅补 `current` 与 `client`。停哪个任务、发什么请求，全部是生产代码。
- 真实流程：提交一条长任务 → 要求它此刻仍是 `pending`/`running`/`waiting` → 经生产 `stopTarget` 算出目标 → 发真实 `task.cancel` → 在同一预算内观察到**同一个 task** 变成 `cancelled`。
- 明确失败而非静默通过：`NOT_ACTIVE`、`READ_ONLY_ROOM`、`STOP_TARGET_MISMATCH`、`NO_CANCEL_SENT`、`STOP_IGNORED`、`CANCEL_UNCONFIRMED`。任务先跑到 `completed` 会被判 `STOP_IGNORED`，不会因为"反正结束了"算过。

### 配套改动

- `orb-rst-scenes.mjs`：注册两个新 key。两条新用例**不进** `all` / `smoke` / `core`，需显式 `-Cases markup,stop`；隔离规则改成按用例名判断，不再靠数组位置。
- `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs`：新增 `extractRuntimeMethods`（源码结构变化即抛错，不静默降级），并把解析器与 `OrbitStopTarget` 纳入生成清单与 `source-manifest.json`。
- `LiveBusiness.test.ets`：`submit()` / `waitTask()` 增加 `untilActive` 分支，让用例能观察运行中的任务，同时仍正确收尾自己的 task trace。
- `run-orbit-device-st.ps1`：HAP 符号门禁补上两个新用例名（原先只校验六条）。
- `orbit-st-report-view.mjs`：补阶段中文名与用例标题，报告里不再显示裸 key。
- `nightly.yml`：`st_cases` 说明同步。
- `README.md`：用例表、选择器说明、以及**每条用例的真实通过条件**。

## 验证

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` | 28 条，26 通过，2 失败 |
| 失败项 | `native stderr warnings…` / `native nonzero exit…` |
| 失败原因 | 本机沙箱禁止 `child_process.spawnSync` 捕获输出（`EPERM`），与本次改动无关：这两条用例及其依赖的 `runNative`（`scripts/orbit-st-tools.mjs`）在 main 上均未改动 |
| `scripts/prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs --compile-only` | 通过，27 个源文件，`OrbitStopTarget.ets` / `CloudMarkdown.ets` 均生成 |
| 生成物语法 | 用 SDK 自带 TypeScript 解析器全量解析 `.ets`，无语法错误 |
| `git diff --check` | 通过 |
| CI `node-ut` | **success**（含 `tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` 全量 28 条，含本次新增断言） |
| CI `ArkTS Code Check` | **success** |
| CI `hypium-ut` | skipped（仓库变量 `ENABLE_HYPIUM_UT` 未开启，与本次改动无关） |

**未完成、不能算通过：**

- 本机真实 HAP 编译未跑成：hvigor 在 `C:\Users\qq567\.hvigor` 写缓存、并在 `node_modules\@ohos\hvigor` 建符号链接，本机沙箱分别报 `EPERM mkdir` 和 `EPERM symlink`（后者即 WinError 1314）。**CI 也没有跑 HAP 编译那条路**（`hypium-ut` skipped），所以 ST 工程的 ArkTS 编译门禁**仍未真正通过**；生成物只做了 TypeScript 语法解析。
- 两条新用例**从未在真实后端跑过**。`all` / `smoke` / `core` 里没有它们，Nightly 也不会自动跑到，需要显式 `-Cases markup,stop` 并配好 Gateway Bearer 与设备。
- 因此本 PR 不宣称 #233/#278/#241 的 ST 回归"已验证通过"，只提供可执行的回归用例与明确失败判据。跑通后再补真实回执。

## 复现

```powershell
# 离线断言
node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs

# 生成 + 编译（需要可用的 DevEco 与符号链接权限）
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases 'markup,stop' -OutputDirectory "$env:TEMP\ST-IssueCases"

# 真实运行（需要 ST_DEVICE_ID / ST_ORBIT_URL / ST_ORBIT_BEARER）
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -Run -Cases 'markup,stop' -OutputDirectory "$env:TEMP\ST-IssueCases"
```

## 说明

- 提交内容只有上述 8 个文件，未包含签名材料、本地配置或凭据。
- `markup` 与 `stop` 跑通后会各自留下真实通过记录，届时再考虑是否纳入默认套件；本 PR 不预先放宽或收紧既有五条用例。

## 关于 PR 来源

本 PR 与 #294 是同一提交（`c6e0812f`）。#294 从私有 fork 发起，CI 的 `Download source snapshot` 用 base 仓库 token 去取 fork 的 tarball 返回 404，两个门禁只跑了收尾步骤就失败，实际未验证任何代码。改为从本仓库分支 `test/st-issue-regression-cases` 发起后，tarball 走 `github.repository`，两个门禁均已真实执行并通过。#294 已关闭。

items.body:
## Summary

Adds a Debug-only direct-connect path for self-hosted Orbit and an English zero-to-running deployment guide.

## Changes

- Parse `orbit.direct` / `orbit.directToken`, require a Debug build, and validate a `wss://` endpoint with no credentials, fragment, or extra query parameters.
- Skip Gateway session activation, credential recovery, and quota probing in direct mode. OrbitHome uses the direct Bearer configuration; the local DigitalMate account login is still required.
- Keep Release behavior unchanged: direct settings are ignored and Gateway authentication is still required.
- Add unit coverage for direct config, startup gating, and build-time config validation.
- Add `docs/developer_guide/deploy-own-orbit.md`, covering image build, single-host Docker Compose with native `ORBIT_ACCESS_TOKEN`, TLS/WSS, DigitalMate Debug setup, acceptance checks, troubleshooting, and a Kubernetes path for the current test cloud.
- Add the guide to the developer-guide index.

## Validation

- Focused Node tests: 141 passed across `orbit-config`, `orbit-gateway-auth`, `sync-app-config`, `startup-presentation`, `gateway-cloud-ui`, `about-you-page-lifecycle`, and `account-worker-lifecycle`.
- HarmonyOS build: `BUILD SUCCESSFUL` (unsigned because this checkout has no signing config).
- The Kubernetes manifest in the guide parses as one PVC, one Deployment, and one Service.

## Notes

- `directToken` is a Debug-only test secret. Release builds ignore direct mode.
- The Kubernetes example creates an independent `orbit-direct` Deployment/Service/PVC and does not modify the existing `/orbit-profiling` route.
- No visual UI change; no screenshots. No runtime deployment is included in this PR.

Closes: N/A

## 问题与目标

DigitalMate 启动器强制写入 WorkSwarm 严格审批策略，普通创建作文文件的命令也会触发权限卡。当前手机链路缺少对应审批凭据，最终只显示“请在云端处理此确认”，无法继续任务。

本次以部署配置控制工具权限检查，默认全部放行（包含删除），并保留 main 原有的细分平台策略。来源为用户反馈，无对应 Issue。当前目标 main 未提供 PR 模板，正文遵循 AGENTS.md 与 CONTRIBUTING.md。

## 最终行为

- 新增部署环境变量 `DIGITALMATE_WORKSWARM_PERMISSIONS_ENABLED`：未设置或设为 `false` 时关闭工具权限检查，不弹工具权限卡；设为 `true` 时启用原有平台细分权限策略。
- 保留 main 原有严格模式、默认询问、读取及指定搜索工具放行、部分搜索别名及付费搜索禁用规则。关闭总开关时这些权限规则不参与拦截，重新开启时生效。
- 额外配置的工具规则与 `rules`、file guard 等字段保留；平台预留工具名继续按 main 原有 allow/deny 策略设置。
- 非法开关值令启动失败，避免拼写错误意外关闭检查。
- 保留现有搜索 MCP、搜索顺序和普通补充信息问答，不增加端侧权限管理或审批 UI。
- 在服务 README 和部署说明中记录默认值、覆盖范围、生效时机与外部 WorkSwarm 的边界。

## 验证

- `python -m unittest test_search_policy test_workswarm_adapter.WorkSwarmTest.test_owned_runtime_uses_canonical_platform_config_and_filters_product_secrets -v`：12 项通过，覆盖默认值、显式开关、非法值、原有细分工具规则、自定义规则保留与重新启用、无输入修改、重复应用、启动子进程环境变量透传，以及原有搜索/超时行为。
- `git diff --check`：通过。
- 核对项目固定 WorkSwarm 源码：`permissions.enabled=false` 时不构建工具权限审批 rail，Team 使用同一全局开关。
- 未进行云端部署或手机端到端验收；本地检查不代表线上已生效。

## 生效范围与限制

配置在托管 WorkSwarm 启动或重启后生效。使用外部 `DIGITALMATE_WORKSWARM_WS` 时，由部署方配置外部 WorkSwarm。开启检查只恢复原生权限策略，本 PR 不补齐手机端审批交互。已有暂停任务不会因此被保证自动恢复；账户登录与外部服务授权仍遵循各自链路。

## 问题

WorkSwarm/SDK 初始化日志会写入文件校验 helper 的 stdout，污染 JSON 响应。即使文件存在、签名有效，server 仍会报文件无法校验，导致任务没有 artifact、主对话没有文件卡片。

Closes #394 

## 修改

- 将 helper 导入运行时和校验期间的 stdout 重定向到 stderr，使 stdout 只返回单个协议 JSON。
- 增加包含初始化输出、stdout logger 和校验日志的运行时夹具。
- 补充真实 helper 子进程，以及本地 server 文件交付链路的回归测试。
- 修改范围仅包含 server 和测试。

## 验证

- 62 项相关回归通过。
- 本地真实 server 使用测试 Gateway，经过 WebSocket、真实 helper 子进程、artifact 入库和 artifact.read 下载验证通过。
- 在实际用户 Env 中只读重放同一凭据：
  - 原 helper 的 JSON 前存在 21 行日志，整体解析失败。
  - 修正代码仅在诊断子进程内存中执行，成功读取 872 字节，与源文件完全一致。

尚未部署。发布后需确认目标用户 Binding 已切换，并重新生成文件完成模拟器业务验收。

recent_merged.body: 连续独立提问时，回复、流式文本、交互卡片和通知定位使用同一份会话投影，按原始提问归属展示。 - 主对话和已有普通聊天房间共用原始提问补齐、提交标识去重和排序。任务先到、用户消息尚未到时，先补齐提问锚点，避免卡片落在本地提问之前。 - 全部待回答/确认卡片进入聊天列表；通知使用最终显示索引定位，聚焦不重排，已处理的卡片不误跳到另一张。 - 草稿和多题进度按交互标识分别保存，更新快照不串用输入；提交和取消仍使用实际任务标识。 - 子任务沿已知的同房间父任务关系归属原始提问；缺失、循环或跨房间关系不猜测归属。流式行保留稳定身份和可观察对象。 Refs #339。范围为未合并提问的端侧顺序、卡片归属及输入状态；不修改消息合并或云端偏好保存策略，不据此关闭整个 #339。 验证： - 基于 main `36659cd7`，提交 `3195c6b0`，保持 **一个 commit**。 - 本地相关回归 **575 项通过**；真实本地快照回放中，两张待回答卡片均在所属提问之后，美食提问的占位行正确去重。 - GitHub [node-ut](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/41168854448/job/124442248060)、[ArkTS Code Check](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/41168854390/job/124442247592)、[CI / gate](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/41168856110/job/124442252640) 均通过。 - 正常应用 HAP **10059** 编译、打包通过；使用原账号登录链路连接 `1.94.211.46`，未包含本地开发凭据或固定输入测试页面。 - **云端主对话回归未通过**：通过模拟器原生输入框发送旅游 A、附近美食 B，均已核对到服务端主房间。A 返回了 `ask_user` 结构化问题，但任务随后为 `failed`；B 也为 `failed`，任务结果均为“这一轮结束了，但没有给出回答。”因此提问卡顺序、独立草稿及回答后继续执行的云端验收仍被阻塞。 真实模拟器截图（正常应用 → 测试环境 → 主对话，未编辑）： PR 差异仅含四个生产文件及相关测试/加载器；截图存放在独立证据分支，未向代码差异加入图片、本机配置或测试应用。

连续对话或回答澄清卡片后，上一轮迟到的完成事件可能提前结束本轮并触发空回复补救。现在按 `chat.send` 请求标识隔离事件，保留提问卡片的交互标识和旧事件兼容性。

另修复成功返回 `[SILENT]` 时仍产生提醒、增加角标的问题。保留现有偏好写入、消息合并及静默任务策略；真实失败和非静默文件交付仍可通知。

问题来源与范围：
- #152：复验“作文请求 → 主题澄清 → 回答主题”时发现恢复执行提前结束、触发空回复补救，本 PR 补请求级事件隔离；不据此宣称原 issue 的全部话题连续性问题已验收。

这两处是回归验证时额外发现的问题，不作为偏好确认插队或连发覆盖的修复关联。

同轮回归覆盖 #81、#241、#86、#291、#67；这些是验证范围，不表示本 PR 新修复了它们。#208 的文件交付由已合入的 #371 处理。

验证：171 项端侧测试、72 项相关云侧测试及 2 个子测试通过；10053 HAP 编译、安装及静默提醒复测通过。两项已确认的旧桌面 API 基线失败仍被排除。云端尚未部署，完整真实模型流程仍需部署后复测。

## Summary

Every pull request now runs the full `pr-ready` composition: Node unit tests, Hypium unit tests and the credential-free device ST, in addition to Code Check. All CI source fetching (Code Check, node-ut, hypium-ut, pr-ready gate, Nightly ST/E2E/image) now goes through the GitHub REST tarball API instead of git.

## Changes

### pr-ready lane (hypium-ut + ST)

- **`scripts/ci/hypium-ut.sh`** — `ohpm install --all` + `hvigorw test`, then require `test_result.txt` to report `Failure: 0, Error: 0`. hvigor exits 0 even when a case fails, so the SDK result file is the real gate.
- **`scripts/ci/st.sh`** — prepare, compile, install and run the standalone ST HAP on a local emulator, then let `tests/st/report.mjs` decide. Defaults to the credential-free `attachment-policy` suite; supports `business` / `connection` / `compile-only`. Reuses a running `127.0.0.1` emulator and starts `Mate 90 Pro` when none is connected.
- **`.github/ci-gates.json`** — `pr-ready` runs the three scripts; per-command timeout 2400s.
- **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`** — composes the lane on PRs, raises the job timeout to 90 minutes, sets `DEVECO_HOME`, and uploads `st-results/` plus the Hypium result as `ci-pr-ready-evidence`.
- **`HtmlHomeRenderer.test.ets`** — fix a stale Hypium assertion: direct-discovery mode renders a settings button and posts `waterfall.home.back` from JavaScript, so `aria-label="返回首页"` never exists in the generated HTML. The suite was failing on `main` while `hypium-ut` was disabled.

### API tarball fetch (no git clone in CI)

- The self-hosted hosts' git-upload-pack to github.com is intermittent while `api.github.com` is stable; Code Check and node-ut already used tarballs. Now **ut.yml `hypium-ut`, Nightly `digitalmate-st` (PowerShell), `digitalmate-image`, `simulator-e2e` and the `ci.yml` gate** download the source snapshot through the REST tarball endpoint too.
- **`update-cloud-digitalmate.mjs`** gains `DIGITALMATE_FETCH=api` (commits API resolves main's SHA, tarball endpoint downloads the snapshot); local runs keep the git fetch default.
- Known pre-existing issue, unrelated here: the image-update script still expects `deploy/digitalmate-image/Dockerfile`, which moved to `server/deploy/` in the WorkSwarm restructure; the step is currently skipped because `E2E_UPDATE_DIGITALMATE` is unset.

## Local verification (main `db299fa`)

Full `node scripts/gate/gate.mjs run --lane pr-ready` → **pass**, 242.5s total:

| Command | Duration | Result |
|---|---:|---|
| `node-tests.sh` | 141.1s | 2420 tests, 2418 pass, 2 skipped |
| `hypium-ut.sh` | 84.6s (incremental) | 2295/2295 pass |
| `st.sh` | 16.8s | 5/5 pass |

API fetch verified live: `DIGITALMATE_FETCH=api` fetched `openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate@1cbee4b` (50 MB snapshot via commits API + tarball); git mode unchanged; full node suite passes.

## Scope

The real-model business ST stays in Nightly: it needs `ST_DIGITALMATE_BEARER` and would call the model on every PR. `ST_SUITE=business` is available when credentials are provided.

> Note: fork PRs do not start `pull_request` workflows until approved (the same applied to #368), so the `CI / gate` job needs an "Approve and run workflows" click on this PR.

当同一任务最终已经返回有效回答，但历史中仍保留早先的 `waiting` result 时，聊天会同时展示“这次没有得到可用回复，请再试一次。”和正常回答。

本次在合并历史与当前快照后，检查已完成任务是否已有可用的助手 result，仅隐藏被替代的 waiting 占位。仅有 waiting 时仍保留原有终态提示；其他任务、真实失败和未完成任务的处理保持不变。空白、内部指令、模型失败和执行服务诊断不作为有效回答。原始历史记录与分页游标不受过滤影响。

Closes #218

### 验证

- 基线：`main` `627d4ac679978f703eaeb9b3ae37f29869fe0996`。本 PR 为单一提交 `69d14e1579170233a5b7f0b0c0d2dc003fe7239a`。设备构建和离线测试使用生产修复源码 `9825ef075f0086f8b0b275e66c84be0a3e89961a`；压缩提交前后完整文件树一致，代码、测试和截图内容未变。
- 104 项相关 Node 回归通过，包含新增 6 项 #218 用例：同任务多个占位、迟到回答、重复快照、重新打开、历史页合并与游标、任务/房间/角色/消息类型隔离、无效 result 和失败/未完成任务。
- 完整 Node 测试集对照：修复版 1718 passed / 35 failed / 7 skipped；未修改基线 1712 passed / 相同的 35 failed / 7 skipped。失败集合完全一致，涉及本地 TypeScript、Playwright、OpenSSL 等依赖及已有平台相关测试；未将其报告为全量通过。
- DevEco 签名 HAP 构建成功，在指定 HarmonyOS 模拟器 `127.0.0.1:5555` / `dm_startup_narrow` 以覆盖安装方式完成真实普通测试环境对照。兼容 WS 入口为 `wss://1.94.211.46/orbit/ws?binding_id=default`，鉴权 API 为 `https://1.94.211.46/api/v1`；包内测试 CA 已逐字节核验。
- 在新建独立房间中，让真实模型首次只输出 `waiting`，再仅重跑同一任务一次，依据会话历史输出唯一有效回答。云端持久保留两个 result；未注入响应或编辑云端数据。随后通过正式 `thread.move` 接口仅将此测试任务移至主聊天，两个 result 的消息 ID 与文本保持不变，其他任务房间未变。相同记录下，基线包同时显示错误气泡和有效回答，修复包仅显示有效回答；下方截图直接取自原生主聊天。
- 修复包实时刷新、重新进入任务，以及强停本应用进程后重启并恢复云端历史均通过。只有 waiting、尚无可用答案时，修复包仍保留合理终态提示。

修复签名 HAP（测试版本 10042）SHA256：`5a27e4256c997857034ab58c14163f817c09c38cdf55a1a53b2c7be62455e21a`。

| 修复前（主聊天） | 修复后（主聊天，重新加载历史） |
| --- | --- |
| ![修复前](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/69d14e1579170233a5b7f0b0c0d2dc003fe7239a/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-218/home-before.jpeg?raw=true) | ![修复后](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/69d14e1579170233a5b7f0b0c0d2dc003fe7239a/docs/developer_guide/validation/issue-218/home-after-restart.jpeg?raw=true) |

## 背景

Nightly 的 E2E 用例原本按模拟器（1280x2832）几何和宽松完成判定编写，在真机（华为畅享 90 Plus / JUY-AL50，1080x2406）上会出现一批与产品无关的失败：需求卡识别不到、产物卡片被点成提示词气泡、回合在第一个流式 token 就被判完成、表格吞掉竖滑手势。

## 改动

- **需求卡按实测屏幕解析**：标题支持 Orbit 的「Beebou 想问你」，选项行内边距/高度/页码容差全部改为屏幕比例（1080 宽时 x=99 也能识别）；收起键盘后再找卡，卡片被顶出可视区时滚动拉回。
- **产物卡片严格匹配**：只接受文件名标签（含省略号截断），不再把提示词里出现的文件名当卡片；卡片不在屏内时按方向滚动查找。
- **回合完成判定**：
  - 宽松回退（new-text / new-text-any）要求页面稳定 1.5s，避免第一个流式 token 就被接受；
  - 卡片提交后没有用户气泡锚点时，用「发送后新增文本 ≥ 400 字」判定方案完成；
  - 90s 稳定窗口忽略状态栏时钟（每分钟跳动会无限重置计时器），修复「正在核对发送」卡死；
  - 云端失败（回复失败 / 云端任务执行失败）自动重跑一次。
- **滚动兜底**：markdown 表格是横向 Scroll，会吞掉竖滑手势；`scroll` 在 `expectMove` 失败后改用列表边缘和更靠上的手势带。
- **真机适配**：锁屏上滑、键盘开合阈值改为按实测分辨率；reset 等进程真正退出最多 15s，进程没起来会重启一次。
- **运行入口**：`run-workflow.mjs` 支持 `--target` / `E2E_TARGET`，输出区分「真机 / 模拟器」；`nightly.yml` 设置 `E2E_DEVICE_TARGET` 时跳过模拟器启动、要求 `E2E_SIGN_*` 签名安装，并把 `--target` 传给 runner。
- 文档和单测同步更新（83 个 e2e workflow 单测全部通过，新增真机卡片几何、产物匹配、表格滚动兜底用例）。

## 验证（真机 JUY-AL50，77TYD26810020780）

- 单条：`DM-WF-TRAVEL-01`、`DM-WF-FILE-02`、`DM-WF-CHROME-01`、`DM-WF-QUOTE-01` 均 COMPLETED；
- 全量：修复完成判定前跑出 13/14，剩余 QUOTE-01 用最终代码单跑通过；FILE-02 两次预览的 UI dump 均显示 FINAL 正文。

> 说明：设备上安装的是当天已签名的 debug 包（重装需要 `E2E_SIGN_*` 或 DevEco keystore 密码）；本轮验证的是 e2e 代码，不是重新构建的 main HEAD 应用包。

**What type of PR is this?**
/kind feature

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:
DigitalMate previously assembled a native Agent SDK inside its server. This change makes bot-agent delegate execution to a separate WorkSwarm Gateway over localhost WS while retaining product tasks, approvals, Source/Memory and the optimized DigitalMate search implementation exposed through MCP.

- Fix the WorkSwarm build input to official release `v0.2.8.beta1`, source `0d6857507236d1299276caf0f6fe09e5baaa4c23`. This is a pre-release. Its upstream pyproject still declares `0.2.5.beta1`; release tag and source SHA identify the actual input, without changing upstream metadata.
- Serve `/digitalmate/ws`, `digitalmate.request` and `digitalmate.*`; retain the previous request dialect at the compatibility boundary for the existing Gateway/phones.
- Rename product modules/resources and migrate old workspace directories, SQLite records/schema and configuration idempotently. The migration is one-way: rolling back a migrated workspace requires its volume backup.
- Prefer WorkSwarm native `mcp_free_search`; use the DigitalMate MCP search as fallback on error or no results. Runtime tool effects require permission handling; cancellation waits for a stop result. Legacy Orbit CA loading and the WorkSwarm Source import are covered by integration fixes.
- Build from a fixed official Python base with separate bot-agent/WorkSwarm venvs. Pinned source exports and local wheels are build inputs only; no WorkSwarm source or pyproject patching, credentials or signing material is committed.
- Retain the requested mobile updates from #304, #327 and #331; #334 is excluded. Existing upstream attribution remains in `server/UPSTREAM.json`.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Related: #315, #329. Deployment validation is still pending; this description does not claim that the issues are verified closed.

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：
Current PR source: `9f419939` (one commit above main `bf114e12`). Original author is retained. Conflicts with current main are resolved. The branch now includes the WorkSwarm Source import fix and native-search-first fallback configuration.

- Previous source `5696731d`: focused pytest **28 passed** (`test_engine_rename_orbit.py`, `test_workswarm_flow.py`, `test_workswarm_adapter.py`, `test_search_mcp.py`). Includes migration idempotency, simulated phone -> bot-agent -> Gateway flow, protocol authorization, stop confirmation, image normalization and MCP contracts. These are not actual v0.2.8 runtime acceptance.
- Previous source `5696731d` device HAP: debug `assembleHap` **BUILD SUCCESSFUL**, SDK signature verification **Verify success**; bundle `com.jiuwen.digitalmate`, version `0.1.0`/`10006`, test endpoint host `1.94.211.46`. SHA256: `267fd48e423555b9a36b0b1f818698284d73ea34c8be93c5ae0cbebc0095d4ce`. Installation and current UI screenshots are pending the coordinated server rollout.
- Previous handoff validation at `a4b4a8a9`: 429 client unit tests and 98 focused server tests passed. That evidence is recorded separately from current-source testing.
- Previous broad Node run was not fully green: 2236 passed, 7 failed and 7 skipped out of 2250; environment/browser/openssl failures remain. Full pytest and CI are not declared passing.
- Current merged-main targeted Node run: **106 passed**, including markdown URL behavior, transcript placement/terminal turns, artifact deletion, profiling and report/performance tests. A broader run was 108 passed / 4 failed; all four are collect-profiling tests invoking a POSIX shell fake-hdc on Windows (child spawn fails). These tests are not claimed passing. CI has not been declared green.
- Service image built and registry-verified: `swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/openjiuwen-online-test/digitalmate-bot@sha256:223cd7c69d7065d83f1190030015043f115087bc9272e3f70750215644144563`, linux/amd64, 13 layers, official base. Both bot-agent and WorkSwarm environments passed build-time `pip check`.
- Old test environment `1.94.211.46`: six scoped workspaces backed up using SQLite online backups and file copies (not an atomic volume snapshot); template 34 -> 35, same Alias at 100% new weight, all **6/6 active at 35 with secondary=null**. Template changed only image; environment, mounts, resources and lifecycle preserved. Two verified old Envs were retired through the management API under the user's test-environment authorization; Bindings and Volumes preserved.
- Follow-up hotfixes moved the test environment through templates 36 and 37; the phone workspace is active at 37. The user verified actual phone search end-to-end. Gateway/CA Node tests: **91 passed**. Search/WorkSwarm pytest: **9 passed**. Connection recovery and Markdown regression: **61 passed**. The PR is squashed to one commit above latest main. A phone HAP was built and installed for Gateway CA validation. Full-suite CI and historical-photo acceptance are not claimed.

**What type of PR is this?**

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:
数字伙伴对话绑定在连接或切换会话失败时没有复位 `loadingRoom`，而 `send` / `submit` 以它作为发送闸门，导致失败一次后发送被永久锁住。

- `selectRoom`：置位后的主体包进 `try/finally` 复位（`refresh()` 会吞掉错误，原先无复位路径）。

不涉及后台快照轮询与 topic-refresh 相关测试。

- 全量 CONTRIBUTING 单测：1675 tests / 1636 pass / 32 fail / 7 skipped。main@d225633 基线为 1672 / 1633 / 32 / 7，失败集合完全一致（本地环境缺 `typescript`、`playwright` 模块），本 PR 无新增失败。

Orbit 聊天里的来源经常以裸域名或无 scheme 的 Markdown 链接出现，端侧 `CloudMarkdown` 只认 `[文本](https://…)`，于是：

- `www.baike.com` / `https://…` 纯文本保持黑色不可点（#305）
- `[CNBC](www.cnbc.com/…)` 渲染成强调色下划线，但 `url` 为空，点了没反应，也复制不到目标（#326 端侧可确定部分）

- `pull_request` → `gate.mjs run --event pull_request`（`build` 报 `not_applicable`，`pr-ready` 跑单测）；
- `push: main` / `workflow_dispatch` → `gate.mjs run --lane pr-ready`（main 没有 build lane，给一份可比基线）；

The validation run used `ENABLE_ORBIT_ST=false` to bypass a stuck Windows runner. That made the job-level `if: vars.ENABLE_ORBIT_ST == 'true'` false, so the job was reported as `skipped` before it ever reached the runner.

## Schedule

- Previous: `0 18 * * *` = 02:00 Asia/Shanghai
- New: `0 15 * * *` = **23:00 Asia/Shanghai**
- GitHub cron is UTC-only; no push/PR trigger remains. The gate runs from `schedule` or manual `workflow_dispatch`.

recent_closed_unmerged.body:
**What type of PR is this?**
/kind test

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

The conversation path — input → send → cloud gateway → model → rendered reply — has no automated end-to-end coverage, so a break anywhere in it is only visible by hand. This PR adds the first device system test for that path. One case, the critical one: send `hi`, expect an ordinary reply.

- `scripts/conversation-hi-system-test.mjs` drives the real app over `hdc` + `uitest` (start, open a new conversation, type, tap send, poll for the reply, keep evidence) and prints `Tests run: N, Passed: M, Failed: K`.
- `scripts/conversation-hi-st-lib.mjs` keeps the judgement as pure functions over `dumpLayout` JSON, so it can be replayed and unit tested off-device. Five states: `pass` / `error` / `busy` / `echo` / `empty`. Candidates come from a baseline diff plus structure (`Row > Text` is chrome) and copy filters (assistant name, task progress, task arrow, timestamp, token stats, clock ticks, error copy). `error` is checked **before** `pass`, so a failure notice can never be read as a reply.
- Locators are semantic: stable `id` first, then the accessibility label, and **no coordinate fallback** — a geometry guess can tap any nearby control and still let the case "pass".
- The send button had no id in `dumpLayout` because `.id()` was set on a custom component instance, which renders no node of its own. `A2uiButtonView` now takes `@Prop buttonId` and applies it to its real container; `HomePage` passes `a2ui-home-send` / `a2ui-home-rich-send`. 14 lines, no layout change.
- `scripts/conversation-hi-st-lib.test.mjs` covers the judgement with 22 cases (including ones copied from real device node structures) and runs inside `node-ut` on every PR, so the rules cannot rot while no device is attached.
- `.github/workflows/ut.yml` adds the `device-st` job: `workflow_dispatch` only, gated by `vars.ENABLE_DEVICE_ST == 'true'`, on the self-hosted `harmonyos` runner, uploading screenshots + every layout dump + `report.json` as `device-st-evidence`. It is deliberately not wired to PR/push events: every run sends a real request to the backend and consumes account quota.
- Docs: `docs/ci.md` records the `device-st` prerequisites (device, login state, and why the job is manual only). The judgement rules are documented in `scripts/conversation-hi-st-lib.mjs` and covered by its test file.

Scope and limits: the case asserts that an ordinary reply arrived; it does not judge whether the reply is on topic, and replies carried only by images/cards are out of reach (tracked in the survey as backlog). `device-st` requires a device whose app already holds a logged-in account, and a build that carries the send-button id.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

No linked issue.

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results (Function, performance, reliability, etc.)**:

- `node-ut` on Linux CI, commit `6c468d9` (identical tree to this PR): **1824 tests, 1817 passed, 0 failed**, line coverage **77.3%** ≥ 55% gate. [CI run 39232416938](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/39232416938)
- `hypium-ut` on the same runs: **2937 passed, 0 failure, 0 error**.
- `device-st`, manual dispatch on commit `2d7e743` (same content; the only later delta is the docs record): **Tests run: 4, Passed: 4, Failed: 0** on device `127.0.0.1:5555` — `ST01` 4.5s, `ST02` 4.3s, `ST03` 18.2s, reply latency 17.5s. Because the branch carries no coordinate fallback, that pass also proves the send button is reachable by id on device. Evidence artifact `device-st-evidence` (2.1 MB: screenshots, every layout dump, `report.json`). [CI run 39230328310](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/39230328310)
- Locally, before pushing: the id fix was verified end to end — `dumpLayout` reports `Stack #a2ui-home-send [1060,1481][1193,1614]` — and the case ran **4/4 green** repeatedly on the same build.
- Judgement regression: `node --test scripts/conversation-hi-st-lib.test.mjs` → **22/22**, including a "never guesses by coordinates" guard.
- Flake seen while verifying, and why it is not a false pass: right after an app cold start the cloud session is not ready and the turn fails with the app's own `对话正在准备，请稍后重试。`; the judgement reports `error`, not `pass`. Re-running once the app is warm gives 4/4. Retry / quarantine / flake metrics for this class are in the survey's P0 list.
- Full local `node --test scripts/*.test.mjs`: **1672 tests, 1668 passed, 2 failed** — both in `scripts/coverage-gate.test.mjs`, the pre-existing macOS `/var` → `/private/var` realpath issue, reproducible on a pristine `8c961f0` checkout and absent on Linux CI.

**Self-checklist**:

- [x] **Design**: The judgement is a pure module with the device driving kept separate; the send-button id is fixed at the source instead of falling back to coordinates. Both decisions and their trade-offs are stated in the module comments and in this description.
- [x] **Test**: 22 judgement cases run in `node-ut` on every PR; the device case runs 4/4 both locally and on the self-hosted runner. Known gaps (image/card-only replies, on-topic judgement) are listed rather than claimed.
- [x] **Verification**: Results, CI links and the residual flake are recorded above. `device-st` intentionally stays manual because it spends backend quota.
- [x] **Interface**: No public API or server protocol change — one new component prop plus test tooling and one gated CI job.
- [x] **Document**: `docs/ci.md` carries the `device-st` prerequisites; the judgement rules live next to the code they describe and are pinned by 22 test cases.

Fixes #392

## What this changes

Adds `docs/product/` — the product baseline that issue triage now follows — plus a contract test that keeps it honest. No runtime code, no dependency, no permission, no setting changes.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/product/positioning.md` | One-sentence positioning, target users, three core JTBDs, pillars P1/P2/P3 (commitment, current implementation evidence, gap, acceptance each), seven hard non-goals, and the positioning conflicts found in the repo |
| `docs/product/competitive-landscape.md` | 5 direct + 3 indirect competitors × 10 dimensions, every row with source, ISO date and confidence level, plus our trade-offs, gaps mapped to pillars, differentiators, what we should not build, and the sources that could not be verified |
| `docs/product/roadmap-6m.md` | Six months, exactly three initiatives, north star + supporting metrics, milestones M1–M3, acceptance targets, non-goals, risks, review cadence |
| `docs/README.md` | Indexes `product/` like the other audience directories |
| `tests/unit/product-docs.test.mjs` | Document contract: no source/date/confidence, unknown dressed as fact, dead repo path, roadmap growth past three items, missing pillar coverage or a broken relative link fails the build |

## Why

The repo had no product baseline at all: `docs/README.md` had no product category, a `竞品` / `competitive` search matched only `server/docs/app-lanes.md`, and issues were already being argued against competitors (#382, #356 reference 豆包) without a shared pillar language. Without one, "why us / why now / what if we don't" cannot be answered and priority is guesswork.

## Evidence discipline (the part worth reviewing)

- Confidence vocabulary is fixed: **事实** (read the primary source this round), **推断** (derived, marked "未核实"), **假设** (no evidence yet). A row whose conclusion is 未知 must be marked 假设, and the test enforces that.
- Verified facts this round come from Mem0's README (Apache-2.0, library/self-hosted/cloud, 2026-04 single-pass ADD-only algorithm, LoCoMo 92.5 / LongMemEval 94.4), Letta's README and self-hosting docs (stateful agents, MemFS, memory & dreaming, `/reflection`, channels, schedules, self-host), and Notion AI's help center (Business/Enterprise, credits, workspace access rules, plan approval).
- Consumer-assistant sources were **not** verifiable: `help.openai.com` and `openai.com` returned 403, `anthropic.com`, `support.google.com`, `support.character.ai` and `help.replika.com` failed to fetch. 豆包 / 小艺 / ChatGPT / Character.AI / Replika conclusions are therefore 推断/假设 and the exact URLs to re-check are listed in `## 证据缺口与待验证`. Search itself degraded to a Bing HTML scrape returning marketing pages, which is recorded rather than used.
- Internal gaps cite dated, checkable evidence: `#250` (cross-turn context loss), `#367` (failures written back into the context), `#377` (reminder chain), `#223` (TTFT), plus repo paths for the memory runtime, the BIM runtime, the overview coordinator and the hash-chained ledger.

## Test

Failing first, then passing:

```
$ node --test tests/unit/product-docs.test.mjs          # docs absent → red
$ node --test tests/unit/product-docs.test.mjs          # docs added → green
✔ 6 tests pass, 0 fail
```

Mutation-checked so the test is not tautological — each of these turns it red, and the assertions name the offending row/path:

1. deleting one required competitor dimension row → `must cover exactly the required dimensions`;
2. renaming a cited repo path → `P1 连续性与记忆 cites a path that does not exist: ...`;
3. replacing a confidence value with a made-up one → `I2 Mem0（开源记忆层） / 定位 has an unknown confidence "确信"`.

The suite is picked up by the existing `tests/unit/*.test.mjs` glob in both `ut.yml` and `scripts/ci/node-tests.sh`, so no workflow edit is needed.

## Non-goals checked

- No feature, no ArkTS/runtime change, no new dependency, no secret, no permission change, no repository setting or label change.
- Not a competitor feature-parity list: the landscape only states trade-offs and what we deliberately do not copy.
- The positioning itself stays a proposal marked 待批准; the repo conflicts (README's task-first narrative, the unsupported 小团队 user, split continuity between on-device memory and the cloud session service) are written down as decisions for a human instead of being silently resolved.

## Known limits

- The contract test constrains document shape on purpose; editing these docs now means keeping the source/date/confidence columns. That is the point, but it is extra friction for future edits.
- No screenshot needed: documentation and a Node test only.

recent_closed_unmerged.body: ## 问题 Origin 对话页（`pages/OrbitHome/Index`）的附件上传链路没有任何类型校验： - 选择器 `DocumentViewPicker` 未设置 `fileSuffixFilters`，任意类型都能选； - `uploadOrbitAttachment` 只校验文件名、非空和 10 MiB 上限，`media_type` 仅由扩展名推导； - 不支持的文件会被照常上传，直到云端任务执行阶段才失败，客户端只能显示兜底的「云端任务执行失败，请稍后重试」。 结果是用户无法判断是格式、大小还是模型能力的问题，也没有任何可操作的提示。 ## 改动 1. **Orbit 上传接入共享导入策略** `OrbitAttachmentUpload` 复用 `file-service` 的 `FilePolicy.validateContent`，在文件读取完成之后、base64 编码与建立 WSS 连接之前校验。被拒绝的文件不产生任何网络请求。 校验覆盖：可执行文件/脚本黑名单、图片魔数、按类型的大小上限。 2. **明确图片支持范围**（`FilePolicy`） 图片仅接受 **JPG/JPEG/ PNG / GIF / WebP**（`jpe`、`jfif` 按 JPEG 处理）。 `bmp / heic / heif / tif / tiff / avif / ico / svg / jp2 / jxl / dng / raw` 现在会直接报错，而不是像以前那样当作 `application/octet-stream` 文档放行。 3. **`media_type` 使用校验结果** 删除本地基于扩展名的 MIME 猜测表，直接使用 `validateContent` 返回的 MIME。 4. **失败提示** 除顶部横幅外，被拒绝的附件会弹出 3 秒 Toast；同批次多个失败时合并为「`首个原因`（共 N 个文件未上传）」，部分成功时保留「已上传 N 个附件」。选择器/整体失败同样会 Toast。 ## 拦截行为 | 输入 | 结果 | |---|---| | `.jpg/.jpeg/.jpe/.jfif/.png/.gif/.webp` 且魔数匹配 | 通过，发送校验得到的 `media_type` | | 图片扩展名与内容不符（如 `.jpg` 实为 PNG） | `图片内容与 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF 格式不符` | | `.bmp/.heic/.heif/.tif/.tiff/.avif/.ico/.svg/.jp2/.jxl/.dng/.raw` | `图片仅支持 JPEG、PNG、GIF 或 WebP 格式，请转换后重试` | | `.exe/.dll/.bat/.cmd/.ps1/.sh/.js/.jar/...` | `不支持上传可执行文件或脚本` | | 空文件 / 超过 10 MiB | `附件需为 10 MiB 以内的非空文件` | | 未知扩展名的普通文档 | 仍按 `application/octet-stream` 放行（≤ 10 MiB） | Closes #332

## Summary
Closes the user-visible leak of internal sandbox / sub-agent diagnostics described in #234.

- New `OrbitInternalDiagnostics` helper detects:
  - sub-agent web-search briefs (`Search the web for… Include source URLs.`)
  - sandbox deploy hints (`openai-codex` + pip/终端安装运行时, Research 没能运行, etc.)
- Maps them to short Chinese failure copy; leaves ordinary assistant prose and legitimate coding help intact.
- Wired through `OrbitConversation` history projection, stream rows, and stream text accumulation.

- [ ] Manual: reproduce search-brief / deploy-hint bubbles → friendly copy only
- [ ] Manual: ask for real `pip install` help → prose unchanged

Does not merge without OK.

## Summary
Fixes https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/218: after a turn goes `waiting` → retry → success, the session still showed「这次没有得到可用回复，请再试一次。」before the real answer / question cards.

## Root cause
`OrbitConversation.apply` hid `waiting` results only while the task was **not** completed. Once `status === 'completed'`, any leftover `waiting` result was mapped to the empty-reply error — even when the same `task_id` already had a real result or question cards.

## Fix
- Add `orbitIsWaitingResultText` / `orbitShouldHideWaitingResult`.
- Hide waiting placeholders when the task is still in progress, **or** when the same task already has a durable assistant outcome (non-waiting result or question).
- Keep「这次没有得到可用回复」only when a completed task’s sole result is still `waiting`.

## Test plan
- [x] `PATH=/home/box/node22/bin:$PATH node --test tests/unit/orbit-adapter.test.mjs` (53 pass)
- [ ] Manual: send a prompt that briefly waits/retries then succeeds — no empty-reply error bubble beside the real answer
- Device E2E not run in cloud

## Notes
- Do not merge until review; per standing workflow.
- Never touches #229.

Fork branch: `niuypei:fix/218-suppress-stale-waiting-error`

recent_closed_unmerged.body:
## Summary
Fixes openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate#255: viewing a failed-task reminder (pet bubble or reminders list) did not reduce the pet badge; only 「知道了」 did.

## Root cause
Failed tasks were modeled as permanent `needs`. `orbitNoticePending()` treated every `needs` as pending, and `markRead()` returned early for all `needs`, so opening the failure never left the attention set.

## Fix
- Split interactive needs (`interactionId` — answer/confirm) from awareness-only needs (failed tasks).
- Awareness-only needs are pending while `unread`; viewing calls `markRead`, which clears local unread and `notification.dismiss` (same cloud path as 「知道了」).
- Interactive cards still require an explicit answer; reads do not clear them.
- Visible failure rows also go through `markRowVisible` → `markRead`.

## Test plan
- [x] `node --test tests/unit/orbit-notifications.test.mjs` (55 pass, Node 22)
- [ ] Manual (HarmonyOS): trigger a failed task → pet badge 1 → open via pet/reminder → badge 0 and reminder leaves current; decision cards still require answer; 「知道了」 still works
- Device E2E not run in cloud

## Notes
- Do not merge until review; per standing workflow.
- Never touches #229.

Fork branch: `niuypei:fix/255-pet-badge-clear-on-view`

## Summary
Fixes https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/256

对话里列出工具时，模型会直接吐出 `orbit_*`、`web_search`、`skill_tool` 等内部调用名，且未区分手机端是否真实可执行。

### 改动
- **展示层脱敏**（`OrbitToolDisplay`）：将 `orbit_*` 与已知内部工具 id 映射为中文；`OrbitConversation` 对流式/历史助手文本与确认卡片 `toolName` 统一走 `sanitizeOrbitVisibleText` / `orbitToolDisplayName`
- **客户端确认清单**（`OrbitToolInventory`）：仅「技能 / 对话附件 / 附近地点」标为可用；网页搜索等标为未确认；浏览器自动化 / 桌面文件 / shell 标为手机端不可用（**不**因清单声称 `web_search` 可用，避免与 #229 冲突）
- 识别「列出工具/能力」意图时，`OrbitConversationBinding` 与 `OrbitHome` 经 `task.create` 注入 `composeToolListObjective()`，禁止模型编造内部名或把未确认项写成可用
- 技能专属「列出技能」仍留给 #254/#263；本 PR 在 intent 上刻意排除纯技能问法

### 与 #254 / #263 的关系
#254 解决技能列表与点选执行，并在技能回合 objective 中禁止暴露工具名。本 PR 覆盖**通用助手输出脱敏**与**工具/能力清单**（非技能中心），互补不重复，不宣称关闭 #254。

未合入。未改 #229。

### 测试
- `PATH=/home/box/node22/bin:$PATH node --test tests/unit/orbit-tool-display.test.mjs tests/unit/orbit-tool-inventory.test.mjs`（8 通过）
- Hypium：`OrbitToolInventory.test.ets` 已挂入 `List.test.ets`

issue:428.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

- 产品定位（v1）：长期陪伴、有连续记忆、边界可治理的个人数字伙伴。JTBD 明确要求「让我清楚知道它能做什么、不能做什么，以及为什么这样做」。连接状态徽标是「它现在能不能行动」的唯一持续可见信号。
- 现状（current main `04621bb`）：`digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/state/A2uiHomeState.ets:274` 的 `connectionStatusLabel(status: string): string` 只返回中文（`连接中` / `连接正常` / `连接异常` / `未检查`），没有任何语言参数。
- 两个真实调用点把这段中文渲染给用户：
  - `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/components/ConfigPage.ets:124` `Text(connectionStatusLabel(this.connectionStatus))` —— 模型服务设置页的连接徽标；
  - `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/components/StatusBadgeView.ets:17` `return connectionStatusLabel(this.status)` —— 工具卡片徽标，由 `ToolConnectCardView.ets:85`、`FlightBoardView.ets:253`、`ComposioAuthPage.ets:99`、`GenericToolResultsView.ets:723/834` 渲染。
- 结果：英文设备上，设置页与工具卡片的连接状态仍是中文。对纯英文/读屏用户来说，这是「不知道它能不能行动」的可见性缺陷（P3 透明可见），不是审美问题。
- 为什么是我们、为什么是现在：第 7/8 轮（#425、#426/#427）已把「本地 UI 文案跟随设备语言、中文逐字节不变、纯函数可断言」这一形状验证为可交付；本轮 round-9 的 primary（每日提醒的授权/撤销面）在 current main 上不存在，因此按 SCOPE 的 FALLBACK B 取一个真实、可断言、服务支柱的质量项。
- 本轮 primary 的排查证据（说明为何取此项，不是绕开范围）：
  - 每日提醒调度入口 `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:5499` 的 `runDailyBimSentinel(now: Date, scheduleNext: boolean = true)` 全仓只有一个调用点 `Index.ets:5549`，且传入 `false`（`void this.runDailyBimSentinel(new Date(), false);`），即 `scheduleNext=true` 的每日提醒路径没有生产调用者；
  - 设置页 `pages/Settings/Index.ets`（94 行）只有账号/配额/About You，`components/BimHomePage.ets` 只有 debug 的「10秒测试 Sentinel」按钮（`:424`），不存在 BIM 提醒开关；
  - 全仓没有 BIM 的撤销路径：`cancelReminder` 只出现在 `pages/A2uiHome/train/SystemOneShotScheduler.ets:105/124`，属于开售提醒。
  - 结论：授权面不存在（存在性条件 a 失败），按硬约束「不得编造失败」不提开关功能，改取一个真实可断言的质量项。

### Design Ideas

- 与 #425/#427 相同的形状：给纯函数加可选 `language: string = 'zh-CN'` 形参，用 `/^en\b/i` 判英文，其余语言回退中文；两个调用点各传一次 `digitalmateClientContext().language`（来源 `model/DigitalMateDeviceContext.ets:14`）。
- 备选（未采用）：引入 locale 框架或全局 i18n 表 —— 超出本轮范围，且与已验证的形状不一致；在组件内写死英文 —— 不可测且会破坏中文默认。
- 备选（未采用）：把徽标改成只有颜色/图标 —— 会降低可读性，与「说清能做什么」相反。

### Involved Public APIs

- 无新增公共 API。仅扩展仓内函数签名 `connectionStatusLabel(status, language = 'zh-CN')`，默认值保证既有调用与中文输出逐字节不变。无协议、无网络、无权限、无仓库设置变更。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- `StatusBadgeView` 被 `ToolConnectCardView`、`FlightBoardView`、`ComposioAuthPage`、`GenericToolResultsView` 复用；这些调用方传入 `label` 时行为完全不变，只有 `label` 为空、回退到连接文案时才跟随语言。
- `ConfigPage` 的连接徽标由 `connectionStatus`（`checking` / `ready` / `error` / 其他）驱动。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- 新增 `tests/unit/connection-status-bilingual.test.mjs`（先红后绿，测试文件在红/绿之间逐字节相同）：
  - 中文默认与显式 `zh-CN` 的四种状态逐字节断言；
  - `en-US` / `en` / `en-GB` 得到英文；
  - `fr-FR` / `de-DE` / `ja-JP` / `ko-KR` 回退中文；
  - 未知状态回退到「未检查 / Not checked」。
- 红：`53aa44e`（仅测试，+84）→ 3 fail / 2 pass，`actual '连接正常'` vs `expected 'Connected'`，`actual '未检查'` vs `expected 'Not checked'`。
- 绿：`f7205fc`（3 文件 +14/−7）→ 5/5 通过。
- 中文逐字节对照 main：`未检查` 9==9、`连接中` 9==9、`连接正常` 12==12、`连接异常` 12==12 字节，全部 identical。
- 全套 node 测试与 main 基线对比见 PR。

### Additional Information

- 风险：`clientLanguage` 在组件构造时取一次设备语言；运行中切换系统语言需重新进入页面才更新（与 #425 相同形状，可接受）。
- 可回滚：单 commit，`git revert` 即恢复。
- 非目标检查：不新增依赖、不引入 locale 框架、不改仓库元数据、不涉及训练/微调、不扩大权限、不记录 prompt/response 正文；不触碰 #425 修改过的文件（`MemoryOverview.ets` / `AboutYouPage.ets` / `AboutYouRenderer.ets` / `Index.ets`），也不触碰 #427 的 `Index.ets` 改点，无合并冲突风险。
- 相关：#425、#426、#427。

issue:426.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

DigitalMate 的「每日一次」主动提醒（哨兵跑完后调度系统通知）目前**只输出中文**：

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/bim/BimDailyReminder.ets:57` `buildBimDailyReminderRequest(fireAt)` → `title: '检查心上事'`、`content: '看看今天有没有需要关注的事项'`
- 同文件 `:87` `buildBimSentinelDebugReminderRequest(delaySeconds)` → `title: '检查心上事（测试）'`、`content: '10 秒测试提醒'`

两个函数都不接受语言参数，调用方 `BimDailyReminder.scheduleNext()`（`:121`）/`scheduleDebug()`（`:125`）也不传语言，最终由 `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:5525`（`new BimDailyReminder().scheduleNext(now)`）和 `:5561`（`scheduleDebug(10)`）在每日哨兵成功后触发。

用户在英文设备上收到的是一条中文通知——这是 P2「主动但不越界」最直接的一处违约：主动触达必须让用户读懂，否则就是噪音。

关联：`#424`（记忆卡片双语，已由 PR #425 处理）是同一类问题的 P1 面；本条是 P2 面，两者不冲突。

### Design Ideas

- 语言来自现有 `model/DigitalMateDeviceContext.ets:14` `digitalmateClientContext().language`（i18n 系统 locale，非法 tag 回退 `zh-CN`），不引入 locale 框架、不新增依赖。
- `buildBimDailyReminderRequest(fireAt, language = 'zh-CN')` 与 `buildBimSentinelDebugReminderRequest(delaySeconds, language = 'zh-CN')` 增加**带默认值**的语言参数；`scheduleNext`/`scheduleDebug` 透传；两个调用点传入 `digitalmateClientContext().language`。
- 仅 `en*` 走英文，其余（含 `fr-FR` 等）保持中文，与 `MemoryOverview.ets` 的既有判定 `/^en\b/i` 一致。
- 不翻译任何模型生成内容；不触碰调度时间、`wantAgent`、`maxScreenWantAgent`、`tapDismissed`、`notificationId`。

### Involved Public APIs

`buildBimDailyReminderRequest` / `buildBimSentinelDebugReminderRequest` / `BimDailyReminder.scheduleNext` / `BimDailyReminder.scheduleDebug` 新增**可选**参数，默认值等于旧行为，现有调用方无需改动即可编译；仓库内唯一调用点为本 PR 修改的两个位置（`Index.ets:5525`、`:5561`）。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- 与通知/后台任务模块（`reminderAgentManager`）只交换原有字段，不改协议。
- 与 `DigitalMateDeviceContext` 的语言判定复用同一来源，与记忆卡片（PR #425）行为一致。
- 不涉及服务端、账号、同步、存储。

### Test Design and Test Plan

新增 `tests/unit/bim-reminder-bilingual.test.mjs`（node:test，直接加载真实 `.ets`：`stripTypeScriptTypes` + `vm`，stub `@kit.BackgroundTasksKit`），先红后绿：

1. 中文默认输出与 main **逐字节一致**（daily 399 bytes、debug 365 bytes，两条路径都比对过 main 与分支的 `JSON.stringify`）。
2. `en-US` → `What is on your mind` / `See if anything needs your attention today`；调试提醒同理。
3. 语言只改文案：`dateTime`、`wantAgent`、`maxScreenWantAgent`、`reminderType`、`tapDismissed`、`triggerTimeInSeconds` 在中英之间完全相等。
4. `fr-FR` 回退中文。
5. 接线断言：`Index.ets` 的哨兵调用点必须把 `digitalmateClientContext().language` 传给 `scheduleNext`。

未覆盖：真机通知栏截图/朗读（沙箱无 HarmonyOS 设备，无 screenshot 能力，故不伪造）；`hvigorw` 编译由 CI `ArkTS Code Check` 覆盖。

### Additional Information

- **为什么是我们**：主动提醒是本产品 P2 支柱的落地形态；一条读不懂的通知直接违背「在合适的时候主动帮助我」。
- **为什么现在**：`#424`/PR #425 已证明该形状（本地文案双语、zh 字节不变）可验收，复用同一判定即可，改动 2 个文件。
- **不做会怎样**：英文设备上每日提醒持续中文，用户无法判断这条通知来自谁、要不要处理。
- **是否只是 parity**：否，不针对任何竞品功能，是自身 §6（中英双语/可访问性）验收缺口。
- **非目标检查**：无模型训练/硬件/社交/多租户；无重型基础设施；无新依赖；不改权限与仓库设置；不改产品定位。
- **风险**：极低。只改本地文案分支，默认值保持旧行为；回滚 = revert 本 PR 提交范围。
- **优先级 / 预估**：P0（验收项）/ 0.5 天。

### 🚀 Background Description 「关于你」是 P1 连续性与记忆的用户可见入口：它把长期记忆概览按 6 类渲染成记忆卡片。当前这张卡片的**本地文案完全写死中文**，与设备语言无关： - `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/memory/MemoryOverview.ets:20` `memoryOverviewCategoryLabel(category)` 只有 6 个中文标题（身份与经历/专长/兴趣与偏好/沟通风格/近期关注/性格推断），没有英文分支。 - `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/html/AboutYouRenderer.ets:130` 固定输出 ``、`关于你`，顶栏按钮的读屏标签固定为 `aria-label="返回"` / `aria-label="重新整理概览"`。 - 真实调用链：`pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:3982` `setAboutYouOverview()` 生成 `AboutYouSection.title` → `AboutYouPage.ets:29` 用 `buildAboutYouDocumentUrl()` 生成 WebView 文档 → `AboutYouRenderer` 渲染。 结果：英文系统上，记忆卡片的章节标题仍是中文；读屏（TalkBack）拿到的文档语言是 zh-CN，并用中文朗读「返回」「重新整理概览」。这违反目标 §6「中英双语、可访问性」，也与 P1「让我清楚知道它记得什么」相冲突——英文用户读不到自己的记忆分类。 **证据（current main `04621bb`，仓库自带 Node 脚手架，无需真机）**：新增 `tests/unit/memory-card-bilingual.test.mjs` 5 条，主分支上 4 条失败、zh 基线 1 条通过： ``` ✔ the memory card keeps its current zh category titles ✖ an English device gets English memory category titles ✖ the AboutYou document declares its language and English accessible chrome ✖ the shipped document URL builder carries the language ✖ the page passes the device language into the memory card titles AssertionError: Expected values to be strictly equal: + '身份与经历' - 'Identity & experience' AssertionError: English document must contain (actual: false) ``` 第三个失败还从 `Index.ets` 抽取真实 `setAboutYouOverview()` 方法体执行：英文设备下 sections 仍是 `[ '身份与经历' ]`。 ### Design Ideas - 复用 App 已有的唯一语言来源 `digitalmateClientContext().language`（`model/DigitalMateDeviceContext.ets:15`，由 `i18n.System.getSystemLocaleInstance()` 得到并校验），不引入 locale 框架、不新增依赖。 - `memoryOverviewCategoryLabel(category, language = 'zh-CN')`：`/^en\b/i` 命中时返回英文标题；其余语言保持中文（与现状一致）。 - `renderAboutYouDocument(token, language = 'zh-CN')` / `buildAboutYouDocumentUrl(token, language = 'zh-CN')`：英文时输出 `lang="en"`、`About you`、`

About you

`、`aria-label="Back"`、`aria-label="Refresh overview"`；中文默认输出保持**字节级不变**（已用 main 版本对比验证 33136 字节完全一致）。 - 两个真实调用点接线：`Index.ets` 的 `setAboutYouOverview()` 与 `AboutYouPage.ets` 的 `documentSource`。 - 明确不做：页面其余中文 chrome（更新卡片、公开账号流程、MBTI 文案）不在本切片，后续单独做；不引入 ArkUI 资源包重构。 ### Involved Public APIs - `memoryOverviewCategoryLabel(category: MemoryOverviewCategory, language: string = 'zh-CN'): string`（新增可选参数，默认行为不变）。 - `renderAboutYouDocument(token: string, language: string = 'zh-CN'): string`（同上）。 - `buildAboutYouDocumentUrl(token: string, language: string = 'zh-CN'): string`（同上）。 - 无数据结构、协议、存储、权限变化。 ### Description of Relevance to Other Modules - `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets`：只有标题生成处传入设备语言。 - `pages/A2uiHome/components/AboutYouPage.ets`：文档源传入设备语言。 - `tests/unit/about-you-renderer-interaction.test.mjs`：以默认 zh 调用 `buildAboutYouDocumentUrl('test-token')`，默认输出未变，保持兼容。 - `digitalmate/entry/src/test/MemoryOverview.test.ets`：单参数调用走默认 zh，断言不变。 ### Test Design and Test Plan - 新增 `tests/unit/memory-card-bilingual.test.mjs`（5 条）：zh 基线；6 类英文标题且无 CJK；英文文档的 lang/title/h1/两个 aria-label 且不残留中文标签；`buildAboutYouDocumentUrl` 带语言；从 `Index.ets` 抽取真实 `setAboutYouOverview()` 方法体、注入 `digitalmateClientContext()->en-US` 后断言 sections 标题为英文。 - 先红后绿：red `4bbe6e9`（4 fail / 1 pass），green `937b462`（5/5）；测试文件在两个提交间 `git diff` 为空。 - 关联回归：`about-you-page-lifecycle` 7/7、`memory-card-bilingual` 5/5。 - 未跑：真机 TalkBack 朗读、Playwright/Chromium 交互测试（本沙箱无 Chromium，CI 同基线跳过）；ArkTS 编译器本地不可用，由 CI ArkTS Code Check 覆盖。 ### Additional Information - **为什么是我们**：记忆卡片的「可治理」必须先让用户读懂自己的记忆分类；英文用户目前读不到。 - **为什么现在**：`#417`/`#420` 已在做记忆可见性/导出，卡片文案是其前置；且这是纯本地文案，改动小、可回滚。 - **不做会怎样**：英文设备上 P1 入口持续中文，读屏语言错误，违反 §6 验收。 - **是否只是 parity**：否，不针对任何竞品功能，只补自身双语/可访问性验收缺口。 - **非目标检查**：无模型训练/硬件/社交/多租户；无重型基础设施；不引入新依赖；不改权限与仓库设置；不改产品定位。 - **风险**：极低。只改本地 UI 文案与 HTML 文档属性，不触碰存储/协议；回滚 = revert 本 PR 的提交范围。 - **优先级 / 预估**：P0（验收项）/ 0.5 天。 - 关联：记忆导出 #419、溯源 #416（同属 P1 可见性）；PR 见回链。 Fledge · DigitalMate · Lead · claimed

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：任务失败时，气泡里直接把内部实现细节抛给用户，包含内部组件名 `Orbit`，并要求用户去「让 Orbit 修正请求」——普通用户既不知道 Orbit 是什么，也没有任何可执行动作。

现场原文（2026-10-30，木稀，请求「帮我找刘三姐被AI改编的视频」）：

> 这次请求尚未完成。
> 请求的步骤没有返回可用结果，暂时无法确认原因。请先检查已完成的工作，再决定是否重试。
> **Orbit 向应用发送的请求不符合要求。请让 Orbit 修正请求后再试。**
> 已读取的页面：https://v.gxnews.com.cn/sp/21777116 …

同时另一段回复把「已读取页面」的抓取元数据（`Source id: v.gxnews.com.cn 视频 | AI人形机器人…`）原样贴进正文，可读性很差。

复现步骤：发起需要调用工具/抓取页面的检索类请求，让工具层校验失败一次。
实际结果：用户看到内部组件名与元数据，任务没有完成也没有可用结果。

- 「已读取的页面」这类元数据应折叠到引用卡片里，不混进正文。
- 若确定是平台侧问题，直接提示「服务暂不可用，已上报」并自动重试，不需要用户理解内部结构。

### Detailed Environment Information Description
